stops.note: originally referring to ambergris, a whale-derived substance
ambergris reached Europe through Arab Indian Ocean trade, and the name passed to Baltic fossil resin, perhaps because both were found washed up on beaches
settled to mean the golden fossilized resin
stops.meaning: fossilized tree resin; a golden color

current_meaning: hardened, fossilized tree resin, often golden in color, or the color itself
